en.title: Find the Student with the Highest Average Grade
en.description:
You are given student grades; each student appears at least once, and grades are 1 to 5. Find the student with the highest average grade; different students have different averages.

The input protocol and the examples in this batch were compiled by CSWork.
en.input: The first line contains n (1..100000), followed by n lines, each with a name (English letters, no spaces, case-sensitive) and a grade (1..5).
en.output: Output the name of the student with the highest average grade.
en.explanation: Process according to the definite rules above; see the accompanying editorial for the approach, proof of correctness, and complexity.
hints: Accumulate the total score and count per name. Compare averages by cross-multiplication to avoid floating-point error.
